intro: We do not publish a price per square, because a number quoted before anyone has looked at your roof is a guess dressed up as an answer. What a job actually costs depends on size, pitch, how many layers are already up there, and the condition of the decking underneath — and that last one is only knowable once we are on the roof. What we can commit to in advance is the process: a free in-home estimate, options at more than one price point rather than a single take-it-or-leave-it number, financing available for the times a roof fails at an inconvenient moment, and a written breakdown so you know exactly what you are getting for your money before anything is signed.
notes: Storm damage is priced differently, because your insurance policy is doing most of the work. We inspect, document the damage, and work directly with your carrier. Our fee does not change based on what the policy pays out.
